# A CAD book that earns US dollars three times, at three different rates.
#
# Each earning is billed and collected in one transaction stated in Canadian
# dollars: the bank takes the US dollars and the revenue line states what they
# were worth that day, so each opens a cost basis at its own rate.
#
#     2026-02-01   1,000.00 USD at 1.30   1,300.00 CAD
#     2026-04-01   2,000.00 USD at 1.35   2,700.00 CAD
#     2026-06-01   1,000.00 USD at 1.40   1,400.00 CAD
#                  4,000.00 USD           5,400.00 CAD of cost
#
# `the_usd_earned_three_times_spent_out_in_four.txt` spends every dollar of it
# across four disposals, drawing each on the cost basis it came from.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:USD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

	type: "Equity"

	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Consulting
	type: "Income"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: "Income"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: "Expense"

	type: "Expense"

	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-12-31 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "3/2"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"

2026-01-15 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 5000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening CAD -5000.00 CAD

	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"

		value: "1300.00"
